_readme: Supplier page details for Airport Business Magazine, gathered 17 Nov 2026 from each company's own website (title, meta description, header logo). Where the site gave no usable logo, the logo is from the company's Wikimedia Commons file. dark:true means the logo is white and is shown on a dark tile. An empty website or logo means we could not confirm one: leave it empty rather than guess. Sector drives the filter on the hub.

ADB Safegate.line: Airfield and airside technology supplier to airports.

Adobe.line: Software for creative work, marketing and document management.

Amadeus.line: Travel technology used by airlines, travel agencies, hotels and others.

Analogic.line: Develops computed tomography and imaging technology, including for security screening.

Assaia.line: AI and computer vision for managing aircraft turnarounds.

ATG Airports.line: Airfield lighting and airfield control systems supplier.

Atlantic Aviation.line: FBO network in North America providing fuelling, hangars and support for aircraft operators.

Avolta.line: Global travel retailer with operations in 70 countries.

Boldyn Networks.line: Network provider whose work includes private 5G networks at airports.

Canteen.line: Food service provider covering vending, markets, coffee and dining.

Collins Aerospace.line: Aerospace systems supplier, part of RTX.

CQC Aeronautics.line: Aviation data platform and engineering tools for airports and airlines.

dnata.line: Air services group covering ground handling, cargo, travel and flight catering.

DOLL.line: Maker of special vehicles, including electric highloaders for airports.

Draxon.line: IATA-certified virtual reality training for ground handling teams.

Evolvending.line: Hot food vending kiosks for airports.

Frequentis.line: Safety-critical communication and information systems, including for air traffic control.

Gebr. Heinemann.line: Travel retail and duty free operator.

HID.line: Identity technology company whose products include face matching.

HiSERV.line: Ground support equipment leasing, maintenance and fleet services.

Hudson.line: Travel retailer running duty free and convenience stores at airports.

Hyundai Duty Free.line: Korean duty free retailer with airport concessions including Incheon.

IBS Software.line: Software for airlines, cargo, loyalty and hospitality.

Kalmar.line: Kalmar Motor AB, Swedish maker of aircraft tow tractors.

Lagardère Travel Retail.line: Travel retail division of the Lagardère group.

Leidos.line: Technology company working across national security, health and infrastructure, including airport screening.

Menzies Aviation.line: Aviation services company providing ground handling, cargo and lounge services.

MultiPoint Engineering.line: MEP, fire protection, technology and commissioning engineering, including aviation projects.

Overdrive IoT.line: IoT platform for tracking workers and improving safety inside buildings.

SITA.line: Air transport IT and communications provider.

SSP Group.line: Food and beverage operator in travel locations.

Swissport.line: Airport ground services and air cargo handling.

Synaptic Aviation.line: AI object detection that monitors each stage of an aircraft turnaround.

Textron.line: Textron GSE, ground support equipment brands including TUG tractors.

Travel Retail Norway.line: Norwegian company that runs Tax Free stores at airports in Norway.

UNEX Aviation Services.line: Jakarta air cargo warehousing and ground handling company.

Veovo.line: Software to plan, predict and run airport operations and passenger flows.

VMD.line: Aviation security services provider, part of Xcelerate Solutions.

Welcome Brain Consulting.line: Neurodiversity consulting, training and accreditation for organisations and venues.

WFS.line: Air cargo, passenger and ground handling services.

WHSmith.line: Retailer of news, books and convenience, including at airports.

XenomatiX.line: Solid state lidar technology, used for scanning pavements.
